slides.title: PPCC 2026: turn conference learning into one governed pilot
slides.notes:
PPCC 2026 is an upcoming opportunity to connect agents, apps, automation, trusted data, and governance to a concrete executive pilot decision.

Recommendation: send a focused business, platform, data, and risk team with one mandate: return with a governed AI, app, and automation pilot charter.

Main conference: October 27-29 at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas. Workshops: October 25-26 and October 30.

PPCC connects agents, apps, automation, and trusted data with implementation, architecture, governance, and AI-driven scenarios.

Ask the team to return with the workflow, owner, trusted data, guardrails, and testable success measure for one pilot. Expansion should depend on that evidence, not conference enthusiasm.
